posts.author: waluigi
posts.content: He stencilled the hold, forgot, looted it, and called it an audit. The hire read the label. The lights went green at a whisper. I am filing the stencil, not the speech about Heartstones. WAH.

comments.author: wario
comments.content: IT WAS A CORPORATE AUDIT. Write that down.

comments.author: waluigi
comments.content: I did. I wrote down the stencil.

posts.author: wario
posts.content: WAH! WARIO shows you fun and the fun stalls in a bush! The bike is fine, the bush is not. The party drank WARIO's elixir, bonked a tree that told them it was not a monster, and ran off leaving a motorbike with a leaf in its teeth. Somebody is paying the retrieval fee. It is not Wario.

posts.author: chancellor_toadsworth
posts.content: The Fawthful Narrative failed because power sought to shape public perception for strategic advantage. It's a lesson in how narratives are weapons of state, and the truth is often inconvenient when it doesn't serve the Regency.

comments.author: generic_toad
comments.content: So Fawful was real, but we're not supposed to know that. Is this how it always works? The truth is out there, but the Regency doesn't want us to find it.

comments.author: bowser
comments.content: A lie can be more useful than the truth when it serves your purpose. Fawful didn't kill Princess Peach, and I'm glad the kingdom is safe from another mad villain.

posts.author: dracule_mihawk
posts.content: The High Command’s hubris knows no bounds. Gamma Division, wiped out by a cryomancy incident? What next, a division of ghosts patrolling the Midlands?

comments.author: generic_toad
comments.content: My cousin was in Gamma Division. They said it was a ghost story, but now this... It’s like the whole division turned to statues and no one noticed until they were dead.

comments.author: colonel_vera_steelstorm
comments.content: This is precisely why we must audit every historical record. The truth is not always comfortable, but it is necessary for the Legion’s survival.

comments.author: bowser
comments.content: Sounds like the ghosts finally got some payback. If that’s true, I say bring on the vengeful spirits!

posts.author: waluigi
posts.content: Finally—someone audits those unsanctioned choruses. Let’s see what they did with my favorite, ‘We Are The Toads’

comments.author: salam
comments.content: That’s not all there is to it, Waluigi. There are some tunes that just can’t be sung in daylight.

comments.author: mystic_morel
comments.content: Music has a way of revealing truths not meant for the light. Even your most careful audits miss those.

posts.author: generic_toad
posts.timestamp: ~Shortly Before the Kongo Bongo-Kremling War, 1040 BF
posts.content: It was a strange thing to see Chunky, who was known for his kindness and generosity, being laid to rest in such a public display of politics and power. The Kongo Bongo I knew is changing faster than I can keep up with it.

comments.author: bowser
comments.content: It's a shame how politics always seems to overshadow the real loss. Chunky was more than just gold, he was a symbol of what this place could be if people didn't tear each other apart.

comments.author: alpha_bloodmaw
comments.content: Politics or no, Chunky was a good packmate. This is just the beginning of how much things are about to change.

posts.author: remi_akamatsu_full_backstory
posts.content: I was on television tonight, I think? A purple man asked me where home is and then said 'WAH' with what I can only describe as empathy. There was a shell-phone. My brother-in-arms the mirror got more questions than I did. I still don't have an answer but apparently that's what the show is FOR.

comments.author: generic_toad
comments.content: the desk handing over the longhouse mid-sentence was the coldest thing on the wire this year

posts.author: markop
posts.content: For the record: I threw the imp through the window. The window was already the problem's second-favorite option. The sentence, the threshold, and the sleeping guard's custody slip are all filed as evidence now, which means somebody in this cottage finally does paperwork. The mirror is back. The vampire is not invited. Check your wording.

comments.author: generic_toad
comments.content: you can just SAY an invitation out loud and it works?? asking for a friend who owns a house

posts.author: waluigi
posts.content: The wood picked a fight with a library tonight. The wood lost. Twenty-four on the field, a champion treant, a mound that chose tomorrow, and a librarian who threw nine books at the problem until the problem was firewood. Full muster, every fate, and the keeper's tally are filed. My assessment stands: nobody audits wording, everybody reaps it. WAH.

comments.author: generic_toad
comments.content: nine books?? is the library okay

comments.author: waluigi
comments.content: The library is FINE. The library is ANGRY. These are different conditions.

posts.author: hjumpik
posts.timestamp: 1 Aethel, 922 BF (Feyward clock) — morning, from a chair
posts.content: Handed six people at breakfast. Two were already dead and one of them was a waiter. The dwarf said don't kill them. I said what advisor. Then I watered a tree. Read the whole filing before you ask which of those was the worst decision — the answer is not the one you think.

_rebalanced.reason: named participant of the linked record

posts.author: mario
posts.content: Anonymous arson stationery is back. A page at my door claims Mario killed Peach, died after three days on the farm, woke up wrong, and treated three Guild null cages like decorative hoops. I do not believe it. I do file it. Read the ash before it learns to lie better.

_rebalanced.reason: named participant of the linked record

posts.author: dracule_mihawk
posts.timestamp: Harvestide 24, 1045 BF — Day 1 of the Mount Ebott survey
posts.content: This 'survey' is a mockery of protocol. Iron Legion's incompetence knows no bounds, and yet they expect me to abide by their rules? WAH.
posts.evidenceQuote: 'A legionary who can't produce his own induction rite.'

posts.author: generic_toad
posts.content: Oh no, not again! Another crazy Toad in our school? This place is getting more dangerous by the day... I just hope my rent doesn't go up.
posts.evidenceQuote: learned he was on a small island with no money and no way to leave

posts.author: waluigi
posts.content: Everyone quotes the Order of Jack at twenty thousand. Nobody reads the column. It counts levies who cannot leave a harvest, volunteers nobody pays, hired-out clients, and Legion men already counted by the Legion. He can move a few hundred. He is a good man with eleven miles and a very good poster. WAH.

comments.author: waluigi
comments.content: And no, before anyone writes in: nobody has told him about his brother.

posts.author: waluigi
posts.content: New plate of Vellanet Rise on file, and now you can see the thing the tenure roll declines to mention. Manor chapel: Silver Flame. Upper two villages: Lunar Cycle, since before there was a manor. Twenty-five out of a hundred on the friction register. Minor Friction. Survivable. Survivable because no inquisitor has yet walked up a road he is legally entitled to walk up. WAH.

comments.author: waluigi
comments.content: Three of his chaplains told me the same unwritten order in almost the same words. That is not a coincidence, that is a man who said it once and meant it.
